hooks.command: if codex exec --output-last-message planning/CODEX_REVIEW.md "Review the changes since the last commit (git diff HEAD plus untracked files). Report bugs, spec mismatches with planning/PLAN.md, and risks, ranked by severity with file:line references." > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo '{"systemMessage": "Codex review finished: planning/CODEX_REVIEW.md"}'; else echo '{"systemMessage": "Codex review FAILED - run codex exec manually to see the error"}'; fi
